blocks.text: Here are five reference screenshots of a real-time trading blotter: instruments (bonds, ETFs, crypto, stocks) shown with a Ticker cell, a Timeline sparkline, an Instrument type, P&L and Total Value, and a Quantity - groupable by asset class with expandable group headers, plus a per-column context menu and a value filter. Build a grid demo from them and make it super sleek. It should update in real time, express the % change versus the previous value through the metadata layer, generate its own random data and groups, and the column context menu should offer sorting only.

I stitched the five screenshots into one reference (they're pans of the same wide grid) and read the renderer APIs. It's a grouped flat table - a single flat column band with rows nested under expandable asset-class headers. Here's the aspect inventory:

rows: Grouped flat table: leaf rows under expandable group headers (Bond / ETF / Crypto / Stock)
Chevron + label + count, with aggregated P&L and Total Value
Round colored avatar + bold symbol + full instrument name
Asset-class text (becomes the group key when grouped)
Signed arrow + delta, then a value pill
Filter funnel + kebab (context) menu per column
Grouping bar with an 'Instrument' chip; a live row feed

blocks.text: A few calls before I build - my best guess is pre-selected in each:

items.question: How should grouping behave?
items.answer: Grouped by Instrument, with drag-to-group and chip-to-ungroup toggle

items.question: Which interactions should work (realtime + sort always on)?
items.answer: Expand/collapse groups, column filter funnel, column resize

items.question: How should the P&L / Total Value delta read?
items.answer: % change vs the previous tick on both columns, via the metadata layer

items.question: How much surrounding chrome to recreate?
items.answer: Grouping bar + a LIVE indicator; drop the app tabs

blocks.text: Going with those. Here's how each aspect maps to a grid mechanism - viewmodel-only, no DataSource or DataModel:

rows: Grid(flat) + FlattenedDataViewModel; group headers via rowFacet + packed rowMeta (depth/expand bits)
Sum over each group's members, rendered on the header row
Stored per-cell in viewModel.metadata.valueCells; the renderer reads it back with getValueCellMeta
Custom cell renderer drawing bars from each row's live price history
Custom header renderer + a popup with Sort Ascending / Sort Descending only
Header popup with search + value checkboxes; filters the leaves
One persistent viewmodel via updateData(); reconstructed only when the column set changes
syncGridTheme light + dark pair, all accents via color-mix so both modes work

blocks.text: Building it now with self-contained generated data across the four asset classes, and light/dark counterparts that follow the page theme.
Draw the Timeline microchart with d3, and make each row's set of bars a single SVG <path> instead of one element per bar.

Done. The sparkline now uses d3 scaleLinear to map index -> x and value -> y, and emits every bar as one rectangle subpath concatenated into the same path data, so the whole series is a single filled <path> (one DOM node) rather than 30 divs. The viewBox is index-space with preserveAspectRatio="none", so it stretches to the cell width.

Make the realtime feed feel selective instead of everything moving at once: (1) every ~3 seconds pick a random subset m of the visible rows (m <= half the visible rows) and tick only those, every 32ms; (2) group aggregates updating faster than individual rows is fine; (3) the value pill should only signal an update - flash on change, then fade out - instead of being permanently present.

Reworked the feed into two loops: an epoch timer (3s) picks a fresh set of m visible rows (m <= n/2), and a fast timer steps only those, so the table reads as a live subset rather than a global churn. Row order is held stable across ticks so nothing jumps. Aggregates recompute from their members on every fast tick, so they move faster than any single row. And the value pill is now transparent at rest and only tints (green up / red down) on a recent change, fading out over ~0.6s.
Slow the tick from 32ms to 150ms. Also, expand/collapse on a group sometimes doesn't register.

Set the tick to 150ms. The flaky collapse was a real race: the toggle was an onclick on the group cell, but the grid redraws every tick, and a redraw landing between mousedown and mouseup detaches the pressed node so the browser never fires click. I moved it to a delegated pointerdown on the stable grid mount (a single event that can't be split), keyed by a data attribute - now it toggles on every click.
Two more: slow the tick again from 150ms to 300ms, and raise the minimum number of updating rows to 3 (sometimes only one updates) - so m ranges from 3 up to n/2.
Both in. The tick is 300ms, and m is now chosen in [3, n/2] each epoch, falling back to min(n, 3) when the visible window is too small for that range.
When a group is collapsed it stops updating - its aggregate freezes. A collapsed group should keep ticking too.

Fixed. The active-set picker only saw visible leaf rows, and a collapsed group's members aren't rows at all, so they were never chosen. I now treat a visible collapsed-group header as an update unit: when it's picked, each tick steps a random member of that group, so the aggregate keeps moving and flashing instead of freezing.
Remove the bottom status line (the 'Rows / Total Rows' count) entirely.
Removed - the status element, its append, and its render block are gone, so the grid sits directly below the grouping bar with nothing beneath it.
